en.name: Abbey Basilica of Einsiedeln
en.summary: A Swiss Benedictine abbey basilica home to the venerated Black Madonna of Einsiedeln.
en.body: Founded in the tenth century around the hermitage of St. Meinrad, the Benedictine abbey at Einsiedeln houses a venerated statue of the Black Madonna and remains one of Switzerland's most important pilgrimage destinations.
